items.title: Jon-Erik Kellso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Jack Pearson who was a great teacher and a good influence.

ctx.x: What about college experience? Did you continue your love of jazz through college?

Yeah. Well like I said, when I was in high school I was playing and getting some summer credits in this program called the Henry Ford Community College Jazz Program, which was directed by a guy names Jack Pearson who was a great teacher and a good influence. And we used to play at the Montreux-Detroit Jazz Festival every summer with that group. And I got to meet a lot of great players there and had some good teachers. And so that’s sort of my beginning of my college jazz training there. And then I went into Wayne…
What was happening with your personal tastes as far as the kinds of jazz you were listening to?
